name: io.github.dockndevai/mcp-openshift
description: Safe-by-default MCP for OpenShift / Kubernetes: projects, pods, logs, deployments, routes.

environmentVariables.name: OPENSHIFT_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: Cluster API server URL, e.g. https://api.cluster.example.com:6443.

environmentVariables.name: OPENSHIFT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token (console → user menu → Copy login command → Display Token, or `oc whoami -t`).

environmentVariables.name: OPENSHIFT_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Username for the cluster's local identity provider (alternative to a token).

environmentVariables.name: OPENSHIFT_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for the local identity provider. Sent only to the cluster's OAuth server.

environmentVariables.name: OPENSHIFT_CA_CERT
environmentVariables.description: Path to the cluster CA bundle (PEM) for TLS verification.

environmentVariables.name: OPENSHIFT_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Access mode: read-only | read-write | admin. Starts read-only; writes need read-write.
